intro: Lesson 37: Resistance. To understand what resistance is and how to calculate it from voltage and current

model.title: A lamp has 6 V across it and 0.5 A through it. Find its resistance.

parts.label: Step 1
parts.text: Write the equation: R = V ÷ I

questions.q: 12 V across a heater, current 2 A. Resistance?
questions.model: R = V ÷ I. Put in the numbers: 12 ÷ 2. That is 6. Unit: ohms. So 6 Ω.

questions.q: What happens to current if resistance increases (same voltage)?
Which has more resistance: a short thick wire or a long thin wire?
In the simulator, change the wire resistance and watch the ammeter. Describe the pattern.
A resistor is 20 Ω with 0.4 A through it. Rearrange to find the voltage.
R = V ÷ I: 10 V, 2 A gives...
Big question: why does a toaster wire glow but the cable stays cool?
questions.a: The element has high resistance, so it heats up; the cable has low resistance.
